messages:
Carlos (ops): paging: increased 95th pct latency on inference-us-east-1. auto-escalation from pd-bot. Customers may be affected. Investigating now.

pd-bot: Incident triggered by service: inference-runtime - High latency detected in us-east-1. Priority: P1. Pagerduty runbook: https://pagerduty.example/runbooks/inference-latency

SRE-Bot: quick check: are pods OOM/killed? run `kubectl get pods -n redwood-inference -o wide | grep us-east-1` and `kubectl top pods -n redwood-inference`

Carlos (ops): running those now. seeing a backlog of requests in the queue and a couple of worker restarts 5m ago.

Raj Patel: I'm oncall. taking lead. @Carlos, paste the output of `kubectl describe pod <candidate>` for a restarted pod and stack traces if any.

Carlos (ops): attaching clipped outputs (sanitized):

```
Name: inference-worker-3
Restart Count: 2
Events:
  BackOff  4m (x3) kubelet Back-off restarting failed container
OOMKilled: false
Containers: inference-runtime
  Last State: Terminated
    Exit Code: 137
    Reason: OOMKilled
```

SRE-Bot: looks like OOM on some workers during heavy batch. Check batching config and mem usage patterns. Also check cache pressure: `redis-cli INFO` and `meminfo` on hosts.

Alice Nguyen: adding support/CS for visibility. Maya/Lila FYI — likely customer impact for high-throughput customers in us-east. Suggest drafting a short customer-facing ack for Zendesk/Intercom while we investigate root cause.

Maya Chen: I'll draft an Intercom quick reply and a Zendesk macro. Keep it concise, no technical details.

Lila Romero: prep statuspage message too. We should avoid overstating impact until we confirm scope; initial message: "we are investigating increased latency for inference requests in us-east-1" with timestamp and that we're working on mitigation.

Raj Patel: mitigation options: 1) scale up worker pool (hotfix), 2) temporarily reduce max batch size to avoid memory spikes, 3) fallback routing to us-west. I'll try 1 & 2 in parallel. Carlos, can you trigger a scale-up?

Carlos (ops): scaling up now: `kubectl scale deployment inference-workers --replicas=12 -n redwood-inference` — applying.

SRE-Bot: Deploybot note: scaled replicas from 6 -> 12 by Carlos (ops) at 1799991205.

Carlos (ops): reducing batch size config: updating ConfigMap `inference-batcher` batch_max_tokens: 2048 -> 1024, applying restart of batcher pods.

Raj Patel: good. while that's rolling, gather affected customers: query logs for 5xx or high p50/p95 anomalies by customer-id. Use this Kibana query: `service:inference AND region:us-east-1 AND response_time:>1000` and group by org_id.

Alice Nguyen: Drafts below — please review and stamp before I push to channels. Keep short and clear.

--- Intercom quick reply (Maya) ---
```
Hi — thanks for the report. We're currently investigating increased processing latency for inference requests in our us-east-1 region. You may see slower responses for a short period. Our engineers are working on a mitigation now and we'll follow up with updates here. If you're seeing errors or critical impact, reply and we'll escalate on your behalf.

— Redwood Inference Support
```

--- Zendesk macro (Maya) ---
```
Subject: Ongoing issue affecting inference latency in us-east-1
Body:
Hi {{ticket.requester.first_name}},

Thanks for reaching out — we're currently aware of elevated latency for inference requests in the us-east-1 region. Our engineering team is investigating and applying mitigations. You may experience slower responses for the next ~15–60 minutes while we stabilize.

If you are experiencing 5xx errors or timeouts, please let us know the endpoint and a sample request id and we'll prioritize. We'll update this ticket when we have a resolution.

Thanks for your patience,
Redwood Inference Support
```

--- Statuspage draft (Lila) ---
```
Short: Increased latency for inference requests in us-east-1
Details: We are investigating reports of increased latency impacting inference requests routed to our us-east-1 region. Engineers are applying mitigations (scaling workers, adjusting batcher config) and monitoring latency metrics. We will provide updates as we have them.
Next update: in 30 minutes or when we have a mitigation result.
```

--- Internal all-hands snippet (Carlos) ---
```
Subject: Incident (P1) — us-east-1 inference latency — ongoing
Body: Team, we detected elevated latency for inference in us-east-1 starting at 11:25 UTC. On-call (Raj) and ops (Carlos) are investigating. Mitigations in progress: scaled worker pool + reduced batch size. Primary impact: increased response times and potential timeouts for high-throughput customers. No data exfiltration. Please route customer escalations to Maya/Lila.
```

Raj Patel: thumbs up on the drafts. One note: in Zendesk macro, include a link to statuspage and a short ETA placeholder. Add `Status page: https://status.redwood.example/incidents/1799991111`

Maya Chen: updated macro with status page link and ETA. Pushing macro to 'incident:latency' category now.

SRE-Bot: Metrics show p95 falling from 1.7s -> 1.1s after scale-up and batcher roll. Error rate unchanged at ~0.3% (baseline 0.1%). Continue monitoring.

Carlos (ops): after batcher change, one of the worker pods still shows OOM on cold-starting a large model slice. Investigating model loading memory footprint.

Raj Patel: action items for next hour:
- Carlos: collect `heap profiles` and container memory snapshots for OOMed pods
- Alice/Maya: send initial customer acks via Intercom and apply Zendesk macro
- Lila: post statuspage initial update and schedule next update in 30m
- Raj: test routing fallback plan to us-west for top 5 affected orgs (manual route update)

Carlos (ops): running `gcore` on PID and uploading to secure bucket for SRE review. link: https://internal-artifacts.company/incident/1799991111/cores (internal)

Alice Nguyen: Intercom ack sent to affected conversation threads flagged by the customer-ops query. Zendesk macro applied on open tickets with matching signatures.

Lila Romero: statuspage initial posted at 1799991310. We'll update with resolution notes.

SRE-Bot: p95 now 0.9s and trending down. Error rate trending down to 0.15%.

Maya Chen: support notes for agents (quick checklist to triage incoming tickets):
1) Ask if customer sees 5xx or just slowness.
2) Collect sample request id, timestamp, and region (us-east-1 likely).
3) If 5xx, escalate to on-call with `@Raj` and add ticket tag `incident:1799991111`.
4) Offer workaround: suggest retry after 30s or route to alternative region if customer can accept.

Carlos (ops): core dumps show model shard memory spike on load path. we will patch loader to use delayed allocation and prefetch on smaller batches. rolling patch out as a canary to 2 pods.

Raj Patel: good plan. once the canary is green, we roll to all. until then, keep customer-facing messages conservative: "we're working on mitigation; performance should improve shortly".

SRE-Bot: canary released at 1799992300 to 2 pods. Monitoring.

Carlos (ops): canary looks stable for 10m, no OOM. beginning gradual rollout by 2 pods every 5m.

SRE-Bot: after rollout p95 ~0.45s, errors down to baseline 0.08%.

Raj Patel: marking incident as "mitigated" internally. Lila, prepare statuspage follow-up with resolution and note the root cause: model loader memory spike causing OOM on heavy batch loads; mitigation: batch size cap + loader patch + graceful scaling.

Lila Romero: final statuspage entry drafted and posted at 1799994000. Will close incident once postmortem scheduled.

Maya Chen: support ticket macro updated with resolution blurb and follow-ups for any customers still seeing issues.

Carlos (ops): handing off to Raj for postmortem and next steps. I'm available for follow-up.

Raj Patel: thanks — taking postmortem. I'll schedule a 30m blameless RCA and add owners for follow-ups (loader fix full rollout, better autoscaling triggers, and improved memory instrumentation).

pd-bot: Incident resolved by Raj Patel at 1799994100.

Carlos (ops): note for future macros: add a short FAQ line for customers on retries and region fallback options. saves support time.

Alice Nguyen: agreed — creating a support cheat-sheet from today's snippets and linking to the incident postmortem when ready.

Maya Chen: thanks team. closing support loop on tickets that were acknowledged.

Lila Romero: closing internal comms thread; will link postmortem once Raj publishes. :white_check_mark:
